work: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie: hou
heading: The prayse of Husbandry. Chap 6.

work: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie: hou
heading: An habitation enforced aduisedly to be followed better late then neuer: made vpon these wordes, sit downe Robin and rest thee. Cap. 10.

work: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie: hou
heading: The Preface. Chap. 4.

work: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie: hou
heading: ¶As true as thy faith, Thus huswifrie saith.

work: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie: hou
heading: A briefe declaration, of mannes inclination. Chap. 46.

items.text: Play not rudely with your better: give him the humility the fox owes the lion; toying and rudeness breed displeasure.
items.citation: Five Hundreth Points, A briefe declaration, of mannes inclination. Chap. 46.
items.quote: Who playes with his better, this lesson must knowe, what humblenes, fox to the lyon doth owe.

work: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie: hou
heading: A description of huswife and Huswiferye.

items.text: Be a stay and support to your husband.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundred Points of Good Husbandry, A description of huswife and Huswiferye
items.quote: the wife of the house, to the husband a stay

items.text: Keep your house and attend to the doings therein, laboring with thrift.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundred Points of Good Husbandry, A description of huswife and Huswiferye
items.quote: The woman, the name of a Huswife doth win, by keeping her house, and of doings therein.

items.text: Dwell quietly with your husband, following this lesson well.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundred Points of Good Husbandry, A description of huswife and Huswiferye
items.quote: shee that with husband, will quietly dwell: must think on this lesson, and follow it well.

work: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie: hou
heading: The preface of the booke of Huswifrie. … 4

items.text: Dwell together as lovers desire.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry, Preface of Huswifrie 4
items.quote: As louers desireth to gether to dwell, so husbandry loueth, good huswifrie well.

items.text: Honor her labor as equal to yours; without her your gain is nothing.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry, Preface of Huswifrie 4
items.quote: take huswife from husband, & what is he than? Though husbandry semeth, to bring in ye gaines yet huswiferie labours, seeme equal in paines.

items.text: Labor faithfully; your affairs have no end, and your pains are as his.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry, Preface of Huswifrie 4
items.quote: Some respit to husbāds, the weather maye send but huswiues affaires, hath neuer none ende.

work: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie: hou
heading: A description of house keeping. Chap. 22.

items.text: Keep a good house, providing for your household and managing it well.
items.citation: Five Hundreth Points, Chap. 22
items.quote: a good house for to keepe

items.text: Give daily relief to the poor, the neighbor, the stranger, and all who have need, especially at Christmas.
items.citation: Five Hundreth Points, Chap. 22
items.quote: Of al other doings, house keping is chiefe, for dayly it helpeth, the poore with releife. The neighbor, the stranger, & al that haue neede.

work: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie: hou
heading: The good Huswifelye Phisicke.

items.text: Provide remedies, herbs, and a wise diet for your household against sickness, and when any are sick, give them comfort and rest.
items.citation: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie: hou, The good Huswifelye Phisicke
items.quote: Good huswiues prouide, ere an sicknes do come, of sūdry good things, in her house to haue some.

work: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie: hou
heading: The commodities of Husbandry. chap. 5.

items.text: Be thrifty and skillful, that your son may have hope and not be left without provision.
items.citation: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry, The commodities of Husbandry. chap. 5.
items.quote: The father an vnthrift, what hope to the sonne

items.text: Rule with knowledge and thrift, that the household may not be quickly undone.
items.citation: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry, The commodities of Husbandry. chap. 5.
items.quote: the ruler vnskilful, how quickly vndonne

work: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie: hou
heading: A digression to hospitalitie. Chap. 19.

items.text: Learn good housekeeping and do not let your husbandry sleep.
items.citation: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie, A digression to hospitalitie. Chap. 19.
items.quote: LEane husbandrie sleeping, a whiter ye must do: to learne of housekeeping, a lesson or two

items.text: Be hospitable: render again what you have received, and do not hoard, for another will spend it without thanks to you.
items.citation: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie, A digression to hospitalitie. Chap. 19.
items.quote: a tyme there is sent thee to rendrit agayne. Although ye defend it vnspent for to bee: another shall spend it no thank vnto thee.

work: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie: hou
heading: The description of husbandry. Chap. 7.

items.text: Be the bond and stay of your wife and household.
items.citation: Tusser, Good Husbandry, Chap. 7
items.quote: of wife & the houshold, the band & the staye.

items.text: Labor diligently in husbandry to provide for your household.
items.citation: Tusser, Good Husbandry, Chap. 7
items.quote: The husband is he, that to labour doth fall

items.text: Work pleasantly together with your wife in husbandry and housewifery, as cousins in blood.
items.citation: Tusser, Good Husbandry, Chap. 7
items.quote: with huswife & huswifery, if it be good, must pleasure together, as cosins in blood.

work: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie: hou
heading: Certaine table lessons. … 5

work: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie: hou
heading: The description of womans age by .vi times xiiii. yeres prentiship, with a lesson to the same. … A Lesson.

work: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie: hou
heading: Mans age deuided, here ye haue, By prentiships, from birth to his graue. Chap. 45.

items.text: Bring up the child as a child during the first seven years.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry, Chap. 45
items.quote: The first vii. yeres, bring vp as a childe.

items.text: Save something for her support.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry, Chap. 45
items.quote: The next, saue somwhat for children and wife.

items.text: Save something for their support.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry, Chap. 45
items.quote: The next, saue somwhat for children and wife.

work: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie: hou
heading: The Ladder to thrift. chap. 8. · 1 … 34

items.text: Take a good wife for companionship and live with her in honest wedlock.
items.citation: Tusser, 500 Points, Ladder to Thrift 8
items.quote: To wed good wyfe for company, and liue in wedlocke honestly.

items.text: Encourage your wife in her housewifery, and treat her gently as one who does well.
items.citation: Tusser, 500 Points, Ladder to Thrift 8
items.quote: To courage wife in huswifery, and vse well doers gentely.

items.text: Train your child up in virtue, so that virtue may correct vice.
items.citation: Tusser, 500 Points, Ladder to Thrift 8
items.quote: To trayne thy childe vp vertuously, that vertue, vice may qualify.

work: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie: hou
heading: ¶Comparing good husbād, with vnthrift his brother the better decernith, the tone from the tother. Chap. 47. … 19

items.text: Attend to the needs of your household at home rather than spending abroad.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points Chap. 47
items.quote: good husbandrye tendith, his chargis at home.

items.text: Keep good fences and close up gaps to protect your property and gain.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points Chap. 47
items.quote: good husbandrie cloesith, & gainith the pence.

items.text: Rely on your own labor and stir yourself to work, not trusting others.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points Chap. 47
items.quote: good husbandrye lustith him selfe for to stur.

items.text: Work to keep your household.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points Chap. 47
items.quote: good husbandry workith his howsold to kepe.

items.text: Give generously to your wife instead of asking her to make shift with nothing.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points Chap. 47
items.quote: good husbandrye saieth take this of my gift.

items.text: Make good shift with a small allowance rather than taking and spending up all.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points Chap. 47
items.quote: good husbandrye maketh good shift with a small.

items.text: Save money in your chest for the future.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points Chap. 47
items.quote: good husbandrye baggith: vp golde in his chest.

items.text: Pay promptly to buy cheaper.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points Chap. 47
items.quote: good husbandrye payeth the cheaper to buye.

items.text: Seek profit so as not to fall into debt and prison.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points Chap. 47
items.quote: good husbandrye spieth where profet to get.

items.text: Be watchful and diligent, like a hawk, not drowsy at fortune.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points Chap. 47
items.quote: good husbandrye rowsith him selfe, as a hawke.

work: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie: hou
heading: Now listen good huswiues, what huswifrie here, set out for a daye, as it should for a yere. · 114 … 123

items.text: Keep the keys and lock the doors and chests at night to prevent theft and waste.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points, Huswifery 114-123
items.quote: Make keyes to be kepers... See dore lockt faste, two keyes make waste.

items.text: Guard against fire by keeping candles away from hay, barn, and shed, and watch over all fires at night.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points, Huswifery 114-123
items.quote: Feare candle in hay loft, in Barne & in Shed, feare flea smock, & mēd breech, for burning their bed

items.text: Send the servants to bed at set hours and call them to rise at appointed times, to prevent mischief and keep good order.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points, Huswifery 114-123
items.quote: In winter at nine, & in Sommer at tenne, to bed after Supper, both maydens & menne... In winter at fiue a clock, seruant arise, in Sommer at fower

items.text: Be gentle, humble, and forbearing toward your husband, and win him with kindness rather than strife.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points, Huswifery 114-123
items.quote: Be lowly not sullen... what wrestling may lose thee, that win with a kisse. Both beare & forbeare...

work: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie: hou
heading: A Comparison betweene good Huswiferie & euill. … 17

items.text: Rise early to attend to the household's needs.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundred Points 17
items.quote: good huswiferie tryeth, to rise with the Cocke.

items.text: Look first to what the household must have, and bestir yourself to see it done.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundred Points 17
items.quote: good huswiferie looketh, what houshold must haue; good huswiferie lusteth, her selfe for to stir.

items.text: Tend the household carefully and see that everything in it is fed.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundred Points 17
items.quote: good huswiferie loueth, her houshold to tend; good huswiferie looketh, that al thing be fed.

items.text: Be thrifty and save for tomorrow, so that want is feared not, and there is enough for age.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundred Points 17
items.quote: good huswiferie spareth, for feare ye wot what; good huswiferie saueth, to day for to morow.

items.text: Maintain a good name in the town, for your good or ill fame reflects on your household.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundred Points 17
items.quote: Good huswif good fame hath of best in the towne, ill huswife ill name hath of euery Clowne.

work: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie: hou
heading: Good Husbandly lessons worthy to be followed of suche as will thriue. Chap. 9. … 37

items.text: Keep the marriage bed undefiled; it wins much honor.
items.citation: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie, Good Husbandly lessons worthy to be followed of suche as will thriue. Chap. 9. … 37
items.quote: True wedlock is best, for auoyding of sinne, the bed vndefiled, much honour doth winne.

items.text: Live in loving agreement, avoiding strife, for where couples agree there is prosperity.
items.citation: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie, Good Husbandly lessons worthy to be followed of suche as will thriue. Chap. 9. … 37
items.quote: where coopples in wedlock, do louely agree: there foyson remaineth if wisedome there bee.

items.text: Before marrying, be prepared to keep house and provide for children; love alone is not enough.
items.citation: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie, Good Husbandly lessons worthy to be followed of suche as will thriue. Chap. 9. … 37
items.quote: Who loketh to marry, must lay to keepe house, for loue may not alway, be playing with douse. If children encrease, & no stay of thine owne, what afterwards follows, is soone to be knowne.

items.text: Be diligent and careful in managing household expenses, even when others sleep, to avoid danger.
items.citation: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie, Good Husbandly lessons worthy to be followed of suche as will thriue. Chap. 9. … 37
items.quote: Good husbāds that loueth, good houses to kepe are oftentimes carefull, when others do slepe.

items.text: Work hard to bring in gains for the household.
items.citation: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie, Good Husbandly lessons worthy to be followed of suche as will thriue. Chap. 9. … 37
items.quote: Good husband he trudgeth, to bring in ye gaines

items.text: Work hard within the home, refusing no pains, for it is as needful as the husband's work.
items.citation: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie, Good Husbandly lessons worthy to be followed of suche as will thriue. Chap. 9. … 37
items.quote: good huswife she drudgeth refusing no paines... yet huswife within, is as needefull as that.

items.text: Be not a scolding mistress; such behavior brings ruin to thrift.
items.citation: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie, Good Husbandly lessons worthy to be followed of suche as will thriue. Chap. 9. … 37
items.quote: A reachelesse seruant, a mistris that skowles... brings rueling to ruwen, & thrift to her graue.

items.text: Provide not often exceeding but always enough; this is husbandly fare.
items.citation: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie, Good Husbandly lessons worthy to be followed of suche as will thriue. Chap. 9. … 37
items.quote: not often exceading, but alway enough: is husbandly fare

items.text: Do not delight in harlots or parasites, even if you have wealth.
items.citation: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie, Good Husbandly lessons worthy to be followed of suche as will thriue. Chap. 9. … 37
items.quote: In substance, although ye haue neuer so much, delight not in parasites, harlots & such.

items.text: Do not keep two houses for pleasure; it brings unmeasured charge and regret.
items.citation: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie, Good Husbandly lessons worthy to be followed of suche as will thriue. Chap. 9. … 37
items.quote: Delight not for pleasure, two houses to keepe, least charge without measure, vpon thee do creepe

work: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie: hou
heading: ¶Thinke on the poore.

items.text: Consider your child's natural bent before putting him to learning.
items.citation: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry, Thinke on the poore
items.quote: aske Nature first, what thereto she doth say.

items.text: Choose carefully who first teaches your child; a crude teacher will spoil him.
items.citation: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry, Thinke on the poore
items.quote: Be wise who first, doth teach thy childe that art, least homely breaker, marre fine ambling Ball.

items.text: Do not put your child under a harsh or foolish teacher; seek one with gentle skill.
items.citation: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry, Thinke on the poore
items.quote: Not rod in madbraines hand, is that can helpe, but gentle skill, doth make the proper whelpe.

items.text: Do not pamper your child or let him miss school, or his good wit will be wasted.
items.citation: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry, Thinke on the poore
items.quote: coeking Māms, & shifting Dads frō schooles, make pregnant wittes, to proue vnlearned fooles.

items.text: Be willing and eager to bring your child's learning to pass.
items.citation: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry, Thinke on the poore
items.quote: apt parents glad, to bring to passe the same.

work: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie: hou
heading: A Digression.

items.text: At the first cockcrow after midnight, rise and see that all is secure; beware of thieves and loose women.
items.citation: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry, A Digression
items.quote: At midnight... noyse ye do heare, loke all thing be cleare. Least drabbs do noy the, and theues destroy the.

items.text: At the second cockcrow at three o'clock, begin your appointed work: knead, brew, mend clothes and shoes; do not waste time in idle talk.
items.citation: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry, A Digression
items.quote: Maydes three a clock, kned, lay your bucks, or go brewe... Leaue gibber gabber, mend slibber slabber.

items.text: Rise at the third cockcrow at daybreak and set to work at once, for the mistress of the house will uncover you and beat you if she finds you sleeping.
items.citation: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry, A Digression
items.quote: Past fiue a clock, holla: mayde sleeping beware, Least quickly your mystris, vncouer your bare... Least mystris do breche you.

work: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie: hou
heading: The good motherly Nurserye.

items.text: Nurse your own child at your own breast, and do not hand him over to a wet nurse.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry, The good motherly Nurserye
items.quote: to make ther own brest, their own child to giue suk

items.text: Do not spend your husband's money wastefully; nurse your child yourself to avoid needless expense.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry, The good motherly Nurserye
items.quote: let huswife be nurse, least husband doth find the, to frank wt his purse.

items.text: Give your child what is fitting: the breast to the baby, discipline to youth, and the rod when he is old enough for correction.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry, The good motherly Nurserye
items.quote: Geue childe that is fitly, geue baby the big, geue hardnes to youth, & geue roperipe a twig.

items.text: Teach and train your child diligently; an untaught child is worse than unborn.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry, The good motherly Nurserye
items.quote: children were better, vnborne than vntaught

items.text: Do not coddle your child into a fool; train him for a useful trade or schooling.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry, The good motherly Nurserye
items.quote: Som cockneis with coekig, are made very fooles, fit neither for prentice, for plough nor for schooles.

items.text: Teach your child to ask a blessing, serve God, and attend church; bless him if he obeys, otherwise correct him with the rod.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry, The good motherly Nurserye
items.quote: Teach child to ask blessing, serue God & to church, then blesse as a mother: else blesse him with burch.

work: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie: hou
heading: ¶Table lessons for wayting seruants. … 5

items.text: Wait at table with diligence and skill, mindful of your duty, not standing idly or gazing about.
items.citation: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry, Table lessons for wayting seruants 5
items.quote: One diligent serviture, skilfull to wayght, more comelyth thy table . . . not minding their duetie, within nor without.

items.text: Do not pilfer food from the table or run about with meat in your mouth.
items.citation: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry, Table lessons for wayting seruants 5
items.quote: Such seruiture also, deserueth a check, that runneth out fisking, with meat in his beck.

items.text: Serve food in an orderly manner so that all who come in order receive their portion; do not let some snatch and others go without.
items.citation: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry, Table lessons for wayting seruants 5
items.quote: So toesed with carmarants, here & there some: and others to want it, that orderly come?

items.text: Do not tolerate servants who steal food or leave others without their portion; correct them as your duty.
items.citation: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry, Table lessons for wayting seruants 5
items.quote: Who dayly can suffer, or else can afoord, his meat so vp snatched . . . and others to want it, that orderly come?

items.text: Serve guests as diligently as your master, so that the table is well attended and all are satisfied.
items.citation: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry, Table lessons for wayting seruants 5
items.quote: So purchasing master, a prayse with the best: gets prayse to him selfe, both of master & gest.

work: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie: hou
heading: Enstructions to Huswiferie. … 20

items.text: Live with your husband as a wife should.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points, Enstructions to Huswiferie 20
items.quote: huswife with husband, to lieue as she ought.

items.text: When your husband is absent, act as head of the house and oversee those who work for their food.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points, Enstructions to Huswiferie 20
items.quote: When husband is absent, let huswife be chiefe, and looke to their labour, that eateth her biefe.

items.text: Keep the house and do not be away from it.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points, Enstructions to Huswiferie 20
items.quote: Both out, not alow, Keepe house, huswife thow.

items.text: Attend diligently to household profit, like a cat to a mouse.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points, Enstructions to Huswiferie 20
items.quote: The huswife so named (of keping the house) must tend on her profit, as cat on the mouse.

items.text: Save what your husband would otherwise refuse, being willing to economize.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points, Enstructions to Huswiferie 20
items.quote: what husband refuseth, all comely to haue, that hath a good huswife, al willing to saue.

items.text: Be ready at need to feed all your household.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points, Enstructions to Huswiferie 20
items.quote: Be ready at need, all thine to feede.

items.text: Use laborers gently, keeping this as a law.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points, Enstructions to Huswiferie 20
items.quote: Vse labourers gently, keepe this as a lawe.

items.text: Make your child civil.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points, Enstructions to Huswiferie 20
items.quote: make childe to be ciuill.

items.text: Keep your servant in awe.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points, Enstructions to Huswiferie 20
items.quote: keepe seruant in awe.

items.text: Look to whatever your husband provides with his money and see how it is spent.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points, Enstructions to Huswiferie 20
items.quote: what husband prouideth, wt money his drudge, yt huswife must loke to, which waye it doth trudge.

items.text: Conduct yourself blamelessly so that no one can slander your life.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points, Enstructions to Huswiferie 20
items.quote: Haue euery where, a respect to thy wayes, that none of thy life, any siaunder may raise.

work: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie: hou
heading: Now listen good huswiues, what huswifrie here, set out for a daye, as it should for a yere. · 57 … 113

items.text: Provide for your husband and make merry together while you live.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry, Now listen good huswiues ... 57-113
items.quote: Prouide for thy husbād, to make hi good there / make mery together, while time ye be here.

items.text: Do not brawl or be jealous with your spouse.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry, Now listen good huswiues ... 57-113
items.quote: No brawlings make, No ielousie take.

items.text: Do not taunt each other before servants or argue loudly, to avoid shame.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry, Now listen good huswiues ... 57-113
items.quote: No taūts before seruāts, for hindring thy fame / no iarring too loude, for auoiding of shame.

items.text: Give your wife her due share of what comes in.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry, Now listen good huswiues ... 57-113
items.quote: Such of corne as cōmeth, geue wife to her fee.

items.text: Tend your young children, for they are always wanting to eat.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry, Now listen good huswiues ... 57-113
items.quote: Yong childrē & chickins, would euer be eating

items.text: Give your servant enough food, but not dainties.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry, Now listen good huswiues ... 57-113
items.quote: Geue seruant no dainties, but geue him inough.

items.text: When dinner is ended, set your servants to work.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry, Now listen good huswiues ... 57-113
items.quote: When Dinner is ended, set seruants to worke.

items.text: Do not begrudge your sick servant; even a little comfort helps much.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry, Now listen good huswiues ... 57-113
items.quote: To seruant in sicknes, see nothing ye grutch, a thing of a trifle, shall comfort him mutch.

items.text: Treat good servants gently.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry, Now listen good huswiues ... 57-113
items.quote: good seruants loke duely, for gentle entreating.

items.text: After supper, declare what work each servant shall do in the morning.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry, Now listen good huswiues ... 57-113
items.quote: Declare after Supper, take heede thereunto, what worke in the morning, eche seruant shall do.

items.text: Make your own candles to save pennies.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry, Now listen good huswiues ... 57-113
items.quote: Wife make thy owne candle, Spare, peny to handle.

items.text: Grant rest to all who have labored.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry, Now listen good huswiues ... 57-113
items.quote: graunt all that hath laboured, time to take rest.

work: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie: hou
heading: The plowmans feasting daies. · ¶This would not be slept. Olde guise must be kept. … 8

items.text: See that the feasts belonging to the plough are not forgotten, and join joy and gladness with comfort for labor.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundred Points, Plowman's Feasting Days 8
items.quote: forget not the feasts, that belong to the plough. The meaning is onely, to ioy & be glad, for comfort with labour, is fit to be had.

items.text: At Shrovetide, give the fat hen to your men if blindfolded can kill her, and make enough fritters and pancakes for the maids, letting the slattern have one for company's sake.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundred Points, Plowman's Feasting Days 8
items.quote: At shroftide to shrouing, go thresh the fat Henne, if blindefilde can kill her, then geue it thy menne. Maides fritters & pancakes, inough see ye make.

items.text: Make us a dinner, spare neither flesh nor corn, and make wafers and cakes, for our sheep must be shorn.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundred Points, Plowman's Feasting Days 8
items.quote: wyfe make vs a dinner, spare flesh neither corne, make wafers & cakes, for our shepe must be shorne.

items.text: Fill the oven full of flawns, and do not worry about sleep, for tomorrow your father will keep his wake day.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundred Points, Plowman's Feasting Days 8
items.quote: Fil ouen ful of Flawns, Ginney pas not for slepe, to morow thy father, his wake day will kepe.

items.text: Give the ploughman his harvest home goose, whether she be lean or fat.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundred Points, Plowman's Feasting Days 8
items.quote: till ploughmā thou geuest, his haruest home goose.

items.text: At Hallontide, remember to provide the seed cake, the pasties, and the frumenty pot.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundred Points, Plowman's Feasting Days 8
items.quote: Remember you therefore, though I do it not: the seede Cake, the Pasties, & Furmenty pot.

items.text: Provide roast meat for the ploughmen on Sundays and Thursday nights, as custom and right require.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundred Points, Plowman's Feasting Days 8
items.quote: good Ploughmē loke wekely, of custome & right for roestmeat on Sūdaies, & Thursdaies at night

work: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie: hou
heading: Now listen good huswiues, what huswifrie here, set out for a daye, as it should for a yere. … 56

items.text: Call the servants to breakfast by daybreak, give them a quick meal, and send them to work.
items.citation: Tusser, Points 56
items.quote: Call seruants to breakfast, by day star appere, a snatch & to worke fellowes, tarry not here.

items.text: Carve the meat and heat the pottage, and give each servant his portion.
items.citation: Tusser, Points 56
items.quote: Let huswife be caruer, see pottage be heate, a messe to eache one, with a morsell of meate.

items.text: Make the maid be clean, and teach her to be attentive when you speak.
items.citation: Tusser, Points 56
items.quote: Make maide to be clenly, or make her cry creake and teach her to stir, when her mistris doth speake

items.text: Use the rod when needed to make the young servants attend to their work.
items.citation: Tusser, Points 56
items.quote: A wand in thy hand, though ye fight not all, make youth to their businesse, better to fall.

items.text: Guard the maid's chastity, and make it dangerous for any to seduce her.
items.citation: Tusser, Points 56
items.quote: with her that will clicket, make danger to cope, least quickly her wicket, seeme easy to ope.

items.text: Punish when necessary, but do not be always scolding.
items.citation: Tusser, Points 56
items.quote: Pay home whē thou fightest, but loue not to chide.

items.text: Keep the servants in awe so that the whole household fares better.
items.citation: Tusser, Points 56
items.quote: Such awe as a warning, will cause to beware doth make the whole houshold, the better to fare.

items.text: Reward good servants and show them favor when they do well.
items.citation: Tusser, Points 56
items.quote: Good seruāts hope iustly, some frēdship to feele and loke to haue fauour, what time they do weele.

items.text: Beat a servant who neglects her work.
items.citation: Tusser, Points 56
items.quote: Ill seruant neglecting, what huswiferie sayes, deserueth her fee, to be payde her in bayes.

items.text: Be careful with rat poison, so as not to poison your children.
items.citation: Tusser, Points 56
items.quote: Take hede how thou layest, the bane for ye ratts for poysoning seruant, thy self & thy bratts.

work: Five Hundreth Points of Good Husbandry united to as many of Good Huswiferie: hou
heading: Good Husbandly lessons worthy to be followed of suche as will thriue. Chap. 9. · 38 … 47

items.text: Govern your servants with reason and skill, and keep a careful eye on their work.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundred Points, Good Husbandly lessons 9.38-47
items.quote: The eye of the master, enritcheth the hutch, the eye of the mistris, auayleth as much. which eye, if it gouerns with reason & skill

items.text: Keep the Sabbath, fish days, and fasting days, and require your household to keep them as you do.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundred Points, Good Husbandly lessons 9.38-47
items.quote: Keepe truely thy Saboth, the better to speede, keepe fyshday & fastingday, as they do fall: what custome thou keepest, let others keepe all.

items.text: Keep your servants from gadding about, except when necessity requires.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundred Points, Good Husbandly lessons 9.38-47
items.quote: keepe seruant fro gadding, but when it is neede.

items.text: Pay your hired workers weekly so they can feed their households, and pay your household servants quarterly so they can buy what they need.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundred Points, Good Husbandly lessons 9.38-47
items.quote: Pay wekely thy workmā, his houshold to fede, pay quarterly seruāts, to buy as they neede.

items.text: Give clothing to those servants who deserve it, but not more than you can afford, so that you and your wife do not go without.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundred Points, Good Husbandly lessons 9.38-47
items.quote: geue garment to suche, as deserue & no mo: least thou and thy wife, without garment do go.

items.text: Do not keep servants who are idle, wasteful, or thieving, but send them away.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundred Points, Good Husbandly lessons 9.38-47
items.quote: Beware raskabilia, slouthfull to worke, proloyners & filchers, that loueth to lurke.

items.text: Provide food for your good wife, for she is worthy to eat.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundred Points, Good Husbandly lessons 9.38-47
items.quote: Good wife, & good childrē, are worthy to eate

items.text: Provide food for your children, for they are worthy to eat.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundred Points, Good Husbandly lessons 9.38-47
items.quote: good childrē, are worthy to eate

items.text: Feed your good servants and laborers, for they earn their food.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundred Points, Good Husbandly lessons 9.38-47
items.quote: good seruant, good laborer, earneth their meate

items.text: Give your children learning and nurture to train them for life.
items.citation: Tusser, Five Hundred Points, Good Husbandly lessons 9.38-47
items.quote: The greatest preferment, that child we cā geue is learning & nurture, to trayne him to lyue.
